tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ 'dir rje sna tshogs rang grol gyi bka' 'bum chos tshan gyis rnam grangs ji ltar bzhugs pa'i rim pa bkod par glegs bam/ ga)pa la/ gsol 'debs kyi skor rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa 'dod 'byung yid bzhin bang mdzod ldeb/ slob dpon rin po che padma'i rnam thar chen mo las brtsams te dri ba'i lan nges don gsal byed ldeb/ nges don gyi lta sgom nyams su len tshul ji lta bar ston pa rdo rje'i 'dzin mdo ldeb/ bcas bzhugs/
